title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): vesicles from noise and the starvation shrink replicate on fresh seed 7, but 81% of the amphiphile is made off the bilayers and K-free bodies persist as long as K-carriers, so E is shared and by construction and the K layer is a beaded, gate-held film on 2 of 6 bodies
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_starve.py unchanged on fresh seed 7 (192^2, t=600, labkit). Vesicles, figure-eights and branched bilayers form from noise by t~50-130 and hold to t=600 (rerun/seed7/sheet.png); K beads along the bilayer of 2 of the 6 bodies. kbudget.py on labkit's saved fields: 82-83% of K autocatalysis happens on bilayer matter (u+1 > 0.6), but only 18-19% of amphiphile production (r K P) does; 41% of K sits in the bath halo around the two K bodies. At t=600 the three K-free bodies (338-835 px, K content 1-5) persist at the same size as the K bodies (493 and 1654 px, K 796 and 1525) (kbudget.txt). Feed cut at t=300 (starve/seed7/sheet.png): every body shrinks to micelle clusters by t~500-600, K-free and K-carrying alike.

observations.S: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=0: white noise everywhere; bilayers by t=51
observations.I: rerun/seed7/sheet.png t=130-600: six discrete bodies (vesicle figure-eight, rings, branched bilayers) at constant size

seeds_run.result: vesicles from noise and the starvation shrink reproduce; K layer on 2/6 bodies only; K-free bodies persist as long as K bodies

controls_run.E: starve/seed7 (feed cut at t=300) vs rerun/seed7 fed twin: all bodies shrink, including those with no catalyst

verdicts.limitation: B not endorsed: K is held on the bilayer by a mobility gate written against u (exp(-4(u+1)), min face), it forms beads on 2 of 6 bodies (labkit K rim/core 0.84 aggregate, 5/30 individually membrane-like), and the bilayer itself is the FCH body, not a layer the body makes (81% of amphiphile is produced off the bilayers). E: amphiphile is made only from P by K and decays (by construction), and it is shared through the bath: K-free bodies live as long as K-carrying ones and starve alike, so the dependence is the population's, not each individual's. One fresh seed; no dt/2 or resolution test.
